title: 第2章 两百年的记忆
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林渊死死按着太阳穴，脑海中翻江倒海。

那被《噬魂术》强行扯碎、吞噬的碧绿光点，犹如一柄柄无形的小刀，在他的识海深处疯狂搅动。

筑基后期修士的两百年庞大见闻，绝非一个炼气期修士可以轻易承受。

他强忍着剧烈头痛，凭借着那颗绝对稳健的道心，强行将那些驳杂的记忆碎片分类、梳理。

一炷香后，林渊眼中的血丝渐渐隐去，一抹惊骇之色却怎么也按捺不住。

“原来……这老狗根本不叫林玄鹤！”

林渊深吸了一口冷气。

在梳理出的核心记忆中，这位活了两百四十岁的林家老祖，其神魂本源根本不是林家血脉，而是一个百年前就该死去的邪修！

百年前，原主林玄鹤在云国边界历练，因贪图机缘，被一名重伤的邪修算计。

那邪修拼着肉身不要，强行夺舍了林玄鹤，从此戴上了林家人的面具，堂而皇之地坐享林家供养，一路修炼到了筑基后期。

这也彻底解释了，为什么这个名门正派的修仙家族，内里会腐朽到如此地步。

一个邪修当了上百年的老祖，上梁不正，下梁又怎么可能不烂？

随着记忆的进一步消化，无数极具价值的情报在林渊脑海中清晰起来。

首先是功法。

林老祖主修的乃是金属性核心功法，《玄金诀》。

这门功法中规中矩，却中正平和，极为扎实，足以一路修炼到金丹初期。

林渊本身就是纯净的金灵根，若能转修这门功法，配合金灵根主杀伐、修炼速度是常人三倍的优势，日后的灵力纯度与施法速度将远超同阶。

除此之外，还有配套的数种法术：一阶的金盾术、金针术，以及到了筑基期才能施展的二阶御器术。

更重要的是那些修仙界常识。

云国的山川地理、各大宗门的势力范围、附近修仙家族的实力分布，以及最隐秘的……黑市具体位置、哪些黑市散修可以暗中交易，全部一清二楚。

“陈万河……林崇山……”

林渊翻看着老祖的记忆碎片，脸色愈发冰冷。

这些两百年见闻中，充斥着修仙界的阴暗与血腥。

陈家老祖陈万河与林老祖表面上因为地盘争夺了数十年，暗地里却多次联手，在荒山古道中截杀无背景的落魄散修。

而林家的嫡系高层，尤其是大长老林崇山，更是早就与黑山上的邪修达成了默契，暗中用家族凡人乃至旁系弟子的性命，去换取精进修为的血丹与阴毒法器。

至于那枚林老祖引诱林渊来灌顶的筑基丹，来历更是血淋淋。

那是林老祖在三十年前，亲手搜魂虐杀了一名侥幸在遗迹中获得机缘的落魄修士才夺来的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Yuan pressed his temples tightly, his mind was in a state of confusion.

The green light spots that were forcibly torn apart and swallowed by the "Soul-Eating Technique" were like invisible knives, churning crazily in the depths of his sea of ​​consciousness.

The two hundred years of vast knowledge that a monk in the later stage of Foundation Establishment has experienced is definitely not something that a monk in the Qi Refining Stage can easily bear.

He endured a severe headache and relied on his absolutely stable Taoist heart to forcefully classify and sort out the miscellaneous memory fragments.

After burning the incense, the bloodshot eyes in Lin Yuan gradually disappeared, but he couldn't hold back the look of horror.

"It turns out... this old dog is not named Lin Xuanhe at all!"

Lin Yuan took a deep breath of cold air.

In the core memories sorted out, the soul of this ancestor of the Lin family who lived for 240 years was not of the Lin family at all, but an evil cultivator who should have died a hundred years ago!

A hundred years ago, the original owner Lin Xuanhe was practicing on the border of Yun Kingdom. Because of his greed for opportunities, he was plotted by a seriously injured evil cultivator.

The evil cultivator fought hard to get rid of Lin Xuanhe's body and forcibly took away Lin Xuanhe's body. From then on, he put on the mask of the Lin family and enjoyed the support of the Lin family in a grand manner. He cultivated all the way to the late stage of foundation building.

This also completely explains why this famous and upright cultivating family has become so corrupt internally.

An evil cultivator has been an ancestor for hundreds of years. If the upper beam is not upright, how can the lower beam not be corrupted?

As the memory was further digested, countless valuable information became clear in Lin Yuan's mind.

The first is the exercises.

Ancestor Lin majored in the core metal technique, "Xuanjin Jue".

This technique is quite satisfactory, yet peaceful and extremely solid, enough to be practiced all the way to the early stages of the golden elixir.

Lin Yuan himself has pure golden spiritual roots. If he can transfer to practice this technique, and cooperate with the golden spiritual roots to master the advantages of killing and practicing three times faster than ordinary people, the purity of his spiritual power and the speed of casting spells in the future will be far higher than those of the same level.

In addition, there are several supporting spells: the first-level Golden Shield Spell, the Golden Needle Spell, and the second-level Weapon Control Spell that can only be cast in the foundation building stage.

What's more important is the common sense in the world of immortality.

The mountains and geography of the Yun Kingdom, the spheres of influence of the major sects, the strength distribution of nearby immortal cultivating families, and the most secretive...the specific location of the black market and which black market casual cultivators can trade secretly are all clear.

"Chen Wanhe...Lin Chongshan..."

Lin Yuan looked at the memory fragments of his ancestor, his face became colder and colder.

These two hundred years of experience are filled with the darkness and blood of the world of immortality.

Chen Wanhe, the ancestors of the Chen family, and Lin, the ancestors of the Chen family, have been fighting for decades on the surface over territory, but secretly they have joined forces many times to intercept and kill unsophisticated cultivators with no background on the ancient roads in the barren mountains.

The senior members of the direct line of the Lin family, especially the great elder Lin Chongshan, had already reached a tacit agreement with the evil cultivators on the Black Mountain, secretly using the lives of mortal family members and even disciples in the collateral line to exchange blood elixirs and sinister magic weapons for improving cultivation.

As for the Foundation Establishment Pill that Patriarch Lin lured Lin Yuan into for initiation, its origins are even more bloody.

It was taken by Patriarch Lin thirty years ago after he personally searched for the soul and tortured and killed a down-and-out monk who was lucky enough to get a chance in the ruins.
